Martin shares how peer support, shared experiences, and practical secure-relating skills can create opportunities for attachment repair, while exploring the roles of spirituality, sexuality, and belonging in building deeper, more secure connections.

picks.title: From Army Ranger to Bible Teacher | Lee Brainard’s Journey of Faith | Signs and Seasons with Karen
picks.summary: Lee Brainard joins Karen on Signs and Seasons to explain why heaven will be far more physical, fulfilling and extraordinary than many Christians imagine. Lee shares his remarkable journey from searching for God as a child to serving as an Army Ranger, trading stocks and eventually dedicating his life to studying and teaching Scripture. We may be fragile vessels, but the treasure inside belongs to God.
